name: Northern Vietnam
climate: A real winter, cool and often dry from November to April, then hot and wet from May to September.
days: 5 to 7 days covers Hanoi plus either the bay, Ninh Binh, or one mountain loop.
summary: Hanoi is the base. From there the usual trips are Ha Long Bay, Ninh Binh’s karst rivers, and the mountain towns of Sapa, Ha Giang, and Mai Chau.
body: The north is the part of Vietnam with four seasons. Winter nights in Hanoi can feel chilly, and the mountains above Sapa can approach freezing. Summer is hot, humid, and stormy, which is also when the rice on the high terraces turns green and then gold.

Travelers usually sleep in Hanoi and add one or two overnights: a bay boat, Ninh Binh, or a mountain town. Doing the bay and a mountain loop in the same three days is a rush. Give the mountains at least two nights.
seoDescription: Hanoi, Ha Long Bay, Ninh Binh, Sapa, and Ha Giang: climate, how many days, and where to go next.
